title: How I Price Every New Offer
transcript: There's called the Van Wesson door pricing analysis. I do this most times when I launch a new offering. There's four questions you ask. Number one, at what price would this be so expensive that you wouldn't even consider it. Number two, at what price would this be so cheap that it would be impossible that it would be able to be valuable? At what price would it be right at the edge? You'd have to really consider it, but you'd end up buying it. And then at what price would it be a bargain, a good deal? So, when I run these, I ask those four questions, but I also ask for the customer stats. So, then I can slice it by saying, what do the rich customers think? What's the pricing curve for them? What's the pricing curve for poor customers? And so then you can get really really accurate with initial pricing.
